protocol.sample_selection: CSV warmup=0/false only; all raw rows retained
protocol.summary: median of per-process statistics, not pooled frames
protocol.percentiles: nearest rank per process; short samples do not establish tail latency
protocol.difference: after minus before; positive milliseconds/percent means slower
protocol.diagnostic_difference: on minus off (off is the before/reference value)
protocol.phase_alignment: scope/key cardinality must equal CSV row count; no guessed last-three slice
protocol.phase_overlap: nested phase times are not additive
protocol.shared_control: CoinGL counted once only after metadata and CSV/log SHA256 equality

parameters.order: API rotation each round; alternate case order and on/off order

protocol.alignment: ordinal by scope/key, only if series count equals CSV row count
protocol.mismatches: raw series retained; no inferred per-frame median
protocol.overlap: phase scopes may overlap; medians are not additive
protocol.combine_validated: original validator calls, including rejected misses
